necessity_paragraph: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness consistent with a history of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation (I48.0) and supraventricular tachycardia (I47.1). To further characterize the arrhythmia burden and correlate symptoms with rhythm disturbances, a cardiac event monitoring study using CPT 93271 is indicated for extended ambulatory assessment. This service is medically necessary to evaluate the clinical condition and is not bundled into another covered procedure.
